items.title: Darius Garland on not putting pressure on himself with how much will be asked of him: “I’m not trying to put pressure on myself at all. I’m going out there and playing my brand of basketball. Me and [Tyronn Lue] talk a lot. He wants me to play fast. I like to play fast.”
